mapper.sql: select update_id, version_no, title, content, published_at, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from biz_platform_update
mapper.select:
where status = 'PUBLISHED'
and (version_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by published_at desc, update_id desc

and version_no like concat('%', #{versionNo}, '%') and title like concat('%', #{title}, '%') and status = #{status}
order by published_at desc, update_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into biz_platform_update (version_no, title, content, published_at, status, create_by, create_time) values (#{versionNo}, #{title}, #{content}, #{publishedAt}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update biz_platform_update set version_no = #{versionNo}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, published_at = #{publishedAt}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where update_id = #{updateId}
